item.tib: dkar mo srid rgyal mchod bskul mdor bsdus
item.coloph: zhes dkar mo srid pa'i rgyal mo'i mchod bskul nyung bsdus 'di ni dgongs pa khyad par can zhig byung skabs/ bka' babs g.yung drung bstan 'dzin blo gros dbang rgyal dang*/ spral sku g.yung drung bstan rgyal/ mched grogs mi lnga bcas kyi ngo skal du/ Dak+ki rig 'dzin bde chen sgrol ma'i dge'i drin las rig 'dzin hA chen 'gro 'dul gling pas lcags rta zla 2tshes 13 la dgon chen srid rgyal gnas su bris pa'o//
